entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return something? I bought my son this VeloBand Pulse thing and he just doesn't use it. I'm a bit overwhelmed by the whole process.
Of course, I can help you look into that. Do you have the order number handy?
Oh, um, yes, I think so. It's VF88615-P. I'm just so confused. I tried to do this online weeks ago, right after Christmas, but the whole thing seemed to be broken.
Okay, one moment while I pull up order VF88615-P. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 15th. Can you tell me more about the issue you had with the website?

It was a complete website error. I filled everything out, but when I tried to get the shipping label, it just gave me a message saying 'system down'. I couldn't print anything. I think I took a screenshot on my phone, but I don't know what to do with it. Can't you just help me?

I understand your frustration, and I'm sorry you had that experience. Let me check our system logs for that timeframe... Yes, it looks like we did have a known outage with our returns portal on December 24th. That matches up with what you're describing.
Yes, that was it! I just gave up after that. I hope it's not too late.

Not at all. I'm looking at your order and our policy. You are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. Given the website issue you encountered, I can absolutely process this return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. You'll receive a full refund once we receive the item.
That sounds so much easier. Thank you again for your help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
